title: euthamia lanceolata
intro: Euthamia lanceolata, commonly known as lance-leaved goldenshield, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family, native to eastern North America. The lance-leaved goldenshield is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a promising remedy for various ailments. Research suggests that the therapeutic actions of Euthamia lanceolata may include its ability to soothe digestive issues and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
